input.summary: Remove the carve-out that gives Commerce One ownership of Developments created solely by Corio where Commerce One supports them.
input.comment: [Playbook] We own the Developments our personnel create, so we have deleted the carve-out transferring ownership to Commerce One wherever it provides ongoing support; Commerce One's pre-existing materials and the Software remain its property. If ongoing support is the concern, we can instead grant Commerce One a licence to use those Developments for support purposes.
